Create two synthetic accounts and select two distinct profiles in a fresh scratch org. Substitute their IDs for the placeholders in the provider metadata files, then deploy three synthetic Salesforce-managed providers without initiating authentication. At API 67.0, query the three providers and require one saved null and two distinct populated IDs before recording each ORDER BY variant. Both AuthProvider flow-default fields are absent from API 62.0 describe; see the existing standard-lookup follow-up capture. FlowDefaultAccountId retained three nulls and is a setup skip.
